# `scripts/fp/overview/`

[Index](index.md)

## `scripts/fp/overview/overview_feature.gd`

extends `FpFeature`

City overview: Tab lifts the camera off the hero into an aerial view of the city, with a marker over every open construction site and a list of them. N / B fly between sites, F puts the hero on the site's sidewalk to watch it go up, G sets a GPS waypoint there, Tab or Esc returns to the street. While it is open the hero stands still (a modal is pushed, so the mouse is free for the list) and the time controls keep working. "Planner view" leaves for the orbit view (Main.exit_fp).

### Constants

- `D = preload("res://scripts/sim/sim_defs.gd")`
- `WS = preload("res://scripts/fp/world_scale.gd")`
- `S = preload("res://scripts/fp/ui/hud_style.gd")`
- `MODAL = &"overview"`
- `FOV = 50.0`
- `BLEND_IN = 0.7`
- `BLEND_OUT = 0.6`
- `DIST_MIN = 2.5`: Camera distance from the pivot, world units (1 u = 20 m).
- `DIST_MAX = 32.0`
- `DIST_START = 9.0`
- `DIST_SITE = 4.5`
- `PITCH_MIN = deg_to_rad(30.0)`
- `PITCH_MAX = deg_to_rad(85.0)`
- `PITCH_START = deg_to_rad(55.0)`
- `HL_CAM = 0.1`
- `HL_FLY = 0.3`
- `PAN_RATE = 1.1`: Pivot speed per unit of camera distance, per second.
- `KEY_ROTATE = deg_to_rad(90.0)`
- `MOUSE_ROTATE = 0.005`
- `MOUSE_TILT = 0.004`
- `MOUSE_PAN = 0.0016`
- `ZOOM_STEP = 1.15`
- `CLICK_SLOP = 6.0`: A press that moves less than this (px) before release is a click, not a drag.
- `PICK_RADIUS = 1.5`: A click selects the nearest site within this many tiles of the ground point under the cursor.
- `REFRESH = 0.5`
- `LIST_MAX = 8`
- `MARKER_Y = 1.4`: Marker label height above the ground (u): over a mid-rise; labels draw through buildings anyway.
- `FULL_LABELS = 6`: Markers nearest the view centre (plus the selected one) get the full label; the rest a percent.
- `STAND_BACK = 1.1`: Without road frontage the hero stands this far (u) from the lot centre: clear of the hoarding, with the whole build in frame.
- `WATCH_PITCH = 10.0`: View pitch (deg, up) after walking to a site, so the rising frame fills the shot.
- `TOAST_GAP = 25.0`: Seconds between "construction started" toasts on the street.
- `SITE_COLOR = Color("#FFB547")`
- `PICK_COLOR = Color("#00E0FF")`

### Properties

- `selected: int`: Tile index of the selected site, or -1.
- `markers: Dictionary`: Open sites by tile index -> marker root (only while active).

### Functions

- `func feature_id() -> String`
- `func setup(p_ctx: FpContext) -> void`
- `func on_world_rebuilt() -> void`
- `func from_dict(_d: Dictionary) -> void`
- `func teardown() -> void`
- `func can_enter() -> bool`: True when the overview may open now: on foot, nothing modal, not paused, flying or talking.
- `func enter() -> bool`: Opens the overview over the hero. False when it may not open now.
- `func exit(blend: float = BLEND_OUT) -> void`: Back to the hero's own camera, easing over blend seconds.
- `func toggle() -> void`
- `func site_list() -> Array[Dictionary]`: Open construction sites other than road paving (one per tile, too many to list), newest first: [{"i": tile, "id", "label", "type"}].
- `func road_site_count() -> int`: Road tiles being paved right now.
- `func select_step(dir: int) -> bool`: Selects the next (dir 1) or previous (dir -1) site in site_list() and flies to it. False if none.
- `func focus_site(i: int) -> void`: Selects the site on tile i and flies the camera over it.
- `func stand_point(i: int) -> Dictionary`: A vantage point to watch lot i go up: the far sidewalk across its frontage street (else the near one), or STAND_BACK from the lot toward the hero when it has no road. {"pos": feet, "yaw": deg facing the lot}, on free ground.
- `func walk_to_selected() -> bool`: Puts the hero on the selected site's sidewalk, facing it, and returns to the street.
- `func waypoint_to_selected() -> bool`: Sets a GPS waypoint to the selected site's sidewalk and returns to the street.
- `func camera_xform() -> Transform3D`: The aerial camera for the current (smoothed) pivot, yaw, pitch and distance.
- `func nudge(pan: Vector2, rotate: float = 0.0, tilt: float = 0.0, zoom: float = 1.0) -> void`: Moves the view goal: pan (xz, u), rotate (rad), tilt (rad), zoom factor on the distance.
- `func self_test() -> Dictionary`
